The '''Livien Magnus Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Most off-worlders visiting the planet landed in this spaceport. The Livien Magnus Spaceport could accommodate up to 75 ships, and was occupied by the [[Ord Radama Spaceport Authority]]. Most non-Human [[Species/Legends|species]] avoided the spaceport, and Ord Radama as a whole because of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[xenophobia]], which ran rampant on the planet.<ref name="Arda" />
